title: Authorization Capability (ZCAP)
description: JSON Schema for the JSON documents defined by the ZCAP specification (https://w3c-ccg.github.io/zcap-spec/): a bare/root Capability, a delegated Capability (a Capability Delegation), and a Capability Invocation. A document matches exactly one of these three shapes — see $defs.

Capability.title: Capability
Capability.description: A bare/root capability: a self-authorizing reference to an invocationTarget, implicitly trusted and unsigned. It has no parentCapability and no proof — a document with either of those is a Capability Delegation instead (see $defs/CapabilityDelegation).

id.description: The unique identifier (URI) for this capability. Root capabilities conventionally use the form 'urn:zcap:root:<url-encoded-invocationTarget>'.

CapabilityDelegation.title: Capability Delegation
CapabilityDelegation.description: A capability that has been delegated from a parentCapability: it MUST carry expires and a proof whose proofPurpose is 'capabilityDelegation'.

id.description: The unique identifier (URI) for this delegated capability, typically a UUID URN or other unique URI.

parentCapability.description: The URI (id) of the capability from which this capability was delegated.

expires.description: An XML Schema dateTime string (UTC, e.g. 2021-11-03T18:33:51Z) indicating when this delegated capability expires.

proof.description: A cryptographic proof (e.g. a Data Integrity proof), or an array of them, created by the delegator's key, with proofPurpose 'capabilityDelegation'.

CapabilityInvocation.title: Capability Invocation
CapabilityInvocation.description: An invocation of a capability: a request/assertion to perform an action against a capability's invocationTarget, authorized by a proof whose proofPurpose is 'capabilityInvocation' and whose 'capability' property references the capability (by id) being invoked.

id.description: A unique identifier (URI), often a UUID URN, for this invocation (helps prevent replay).

action.description: The action being invoked (e.g. 'read', 'write', 'Drive'). Some deployments instead (or additionally) use 'capabilityAction'.

capabilityAction.description: The action being invoked; an alternate/legacy property name for 'action' used by some deployments.

proof.description: A cryptographic proof, or an array of them, created by the invoker's key, with proofPurpose 'capabilityInvocation' and a 'capability' reference to the capability being invoked.

context.description: JSON-LD context(s). MUST include the zcap context; capability delegations and invocations typically also include a cryptosuite context used by 'proof'.

controller.description: One or more URIs identifying the entity or entities authorized to invoke (or further delegate) this capability. Often a did: URI or a verification method / key URI.

invocationTarget.description: The URI of the resource, or the object describing the resource, that a capability may be invoked against.

allowedAction.description: One or more actions this capability authorizes when invoked. If omitted, all actions available on the invocationTarget are allowed. A delegated capability's allowedAction MUST be equal to, or a subset of, its parent's allowedAction.

caveat.description: A caveat further restricting how/when a capability may be invoked (e.g. a validity period, allowed IP range, required multi-invocation, etc). The 'type' identifies the caveat's semantics; other properties are caveat-specific.

type.description: The type of caveat, e.g. 'ValidUntil', 'AllowedTarget', etc.

caveatOrCaveats.description: One or more caveats (additional conditions/restrictions) that must be satisfied for the capability to be considered valid when invoked.

delegationProof.description: A Data Integrity (or similar) cryptographic proof object attached to a Capability Delegation.

type.description: The cryptographic suite used to create the proof, e.g. 'Ed25519Signature2020'.

created.description: Timestamp when the proof was created.

verificationMethod.description: URI of the key/verification method used to create the proof.

proofPurpose.description: MUST be 'capabilityDelegation' for a Capability Delegation's proof.

capabilityChain.description: The chain of capabilities (root through immediate parent) that authorize this delegation. Each entry is either a capability id (URI) or, for the parent, the full embedded capability object.

jws.description: A detached JWS signature value, used by some cryptosuites instead of proofValue.

invocationProof.description: A Data Integrity (or similar) cryptographic proof object attached to a Capability Invocation.

type.description: The cryptographic suite used to create the proof, e.g. 'Ed25519Signature2020' (modern) or 'RsaSignature2016' (legacy).

created.description: Timestamp when the proof was created.

verificationMethod.description: URI of the key/verification method used to create the proof.

creator.description: Legacy/alternate property naming the key used to create the proof, used instead of 'verificationMethod' by some (e.g. older RsaSignature2016-style) proofs.

proofPurpose.description: MUST be 'capabilityInvocation' for a Capability Invocation's proof.

capability.description: The id (URI) of the capability being invoked.

capabilityAction.description: The action being invoked against the capability, when not specified at the top level of the invocation.

jws.description: A detached JWS signature value, used by some cryptosuites instead of proofValue.

signatureValue.description: Legacy/alternate property naming the encoded signature value, used instead of 'proofValue'/'jws' by some (e.g. older RsaSignature2016-style) proofs.
